svg.title: Sesión Agendada · Studio booking platform
svg.desc: Sesión Agendada, Studio booking platform (Web · Sep 2024). A booking platform for recording studios. People browse studios, book time and manage their reservations in one place, and chat with the studio in real time. Every confirmed session syncs to Google Calendar, so it lands in their own schedule.

div.p: A booking platform for recording studios. People browse studios, book time and manage their reservations in one place, and chat with the studio in real time. Every confirmed session syncs to Google Calendar, so it lands in their own schedule.
